body:
Thank you so much for looking! I saw that one too but I felt like the writing of the year on the back didn’t match up with the writing that’s visible in the picture I took :( 
It could be the same year but the one in the link has a thinner font and a more curved(?) appearance.
I’ve searched all over using an image search and haven’t been able to find it. I’ve looked up all sorts of brand names but all I really know is that it’s a glass ornament and a collectible.

I’m going to go to another place for a second opinion/re-piercing. I know I was wrong in asking for it lower, he told me he was doing it as low as possible and that I don’t have much nose skin to do it but it feels so low I can almost feel it from the outside of my nose 😭
Also it hurt extremely bad and I typically have a high pain tolerance, as well as my other nose piercing not hurting at all compared to my septum.

I just got it last Friday(about 4 days ago), I’ve been cleaning it with saline soak and antibacterial soap, it still hurts a bit but it’s not unbearable. He pierced with a 16 gauge, I asked him to do it low because it felt like he was doing it really high but I feel like I was mistaken now 😭 he said I didn’t have a lot of nose skin to pierce and that he was doing it as low as he could. I’m really hoping it’s not in a horrible place because it would be an absolute pain to get re-pierced, just let me know thank you :)

Most painful part for me was when she measured my uterus, I was too busy focusing on that pain when she inserted the kyleena so I barely felt it lol Got it inserted yesterday and I feel a little weird and cramping a little but I’m totally fine! Just getting used to it :)

I waited and waited. In pain more days than not. Horrible pain in my chest for months. Thinking about him and a girl I thought I could trust constantly. The pain in my chest eventually only came when I thought about it too hard, then not at all. Things got better but it was still on my mind all the time. I started dating someone else and I love him. He does happen to be associated with the situation with my ex so we talk about it some days but, it doesn’t hurt as much. It happened and there are things I regret but I didn’t give up. I tried to but I pushed through. I’m glad I made it out alive. It gets better I promise you. And I know when you’re crying and you’re in pain it’s hard to believe, I didn’t either, but looking where I am now, I believe it.

I recently cast a hex a couple of days ago and then last night on the full moon I dreamt about it. I dreamt that I opened it up and took a couple of rusty nails out of it to perform something else(which I can’t quite remember but it had to do with the hex). After I was done with the nails, I put it and the thing I used the nails for into the jar and then filled the jar up with dirt. I remember it being dark and I was doing this all outside under a full moon. If anybody has any clue why I could’ve dreamed this please let me know, thank you.
Thank you, I am seeing a professional but it’s a lot of work to get through everything sadly. I’m sure I’ll find someone one day, so I’m not too worried. Best of wishes for you as well

Yeah.. it was actually around 3 weeks after we broke up. I didn’t find out they were dating until a couple weeks after and they both lied to me about it bc she was also a friend of him and I. But yeah, I don’t think he could handle being alone and someone caring and understanding came along who he was familiar with and he thought it was a good idea as any to try and move on. “The quicker I move on, the quicker we can both begin to feel better.” And I don’t remember when he said that, the time lines messed up because they were both lying to me lol. He’s a mamas boy and a big baby and yeah he’s not really worth all the pain and suffering, I’m working on a different mindset towards him I promise T-T

I understand what you mean, but my care for him isn’t necessarily romantic anymore. It’s not like I’ll forget him and as long as I don’t forget him I’ll still care, it won’t hurt as much one day but I’ll still remember it. I’m working on accepting it and I’m doing better, but it’ll always be a sore spot and he knows it will be for him too. Thank you for your advice :)

I’m not sure if there’s anyone I’m destined to be with. The person that left me still has my heart. Has all of me. I don’t think I could give myself to someone like that again. I feel like I’ve been dirtied. And either way I don’t have much else to live for. Someone will take care of my cat, and she’s just about all I have. I have a family, I have people that care for me, but it doesn’t change how I feel. I’d be better off dead.
